script:
export const meta = {
  name: 'glm52-layer-ab-replicate-new-regimes',
  description: 'Second independent interleaved A/B run for decode_bs512 and decode_bs1024, one regime per GPU',
  phases: [
    { title: 'Replicate', detail: 'independent A/B re-measurement, bs512 on GPU1, bs1024 on GPU3' },
  ],
}

const COMMON = `
You are running one benchmark command for a GPU kernel-fusion study on a **MetaX C500**, then
sanity-checking its output. Do not modify any source file. Do not tune anything. Do not
"improve" the script. The point is an INDEPENDENT REPLICATE of a measurement that already
exists, so the two runs can be compared — changing anything would defeat that.

Environment:
- Python: /home/zhangshuhan/my-envs/fusion/bin/python
- Working dir: /home/zhangshuhan/fusion  (run from here)
- **Your GPU is exclusive. Prefix the command with CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=<N>** (your N below).
  Another agent is benchmarking on the other GPU; never touch it. GPU 2 is hardware-dead.
- The run takes roughly 15-25 minutes. Launch it with nohup writing to a log file, then poll
  the log rather than blocking a foreground call for that long, e.g.:

    cd /home/zhangshuhan/fusion && CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=<N> nohup \\
      /home/zhangshuhan/my-envs/fusion/bin/python -u glm52/bench/bench_layer_ab.py \\
      --regimes <REGIME> --rounds 8 --rep 15 --top 5 --force K_f3_f8,D_f6 \\
      --out <OUTNAME> > /tmp/ab_<REGIME>.log 2>&1 & disown

  Then check /tmp/ab_<REGIME>.log periodically until it prints "wrote results/<OUTNAME>.json".
  Do NOT chain short sleeps in a loop to poll; use a single long sleep between checks.

What the script does: it times ~7 whole-layer fusion CONFIGURATIONS end to end, over 8
interleaved rounds (within each round every configuration is timed once, in a fixed order, so
drift affecting a whole round cancels in the per-configuration median). It reports a winner
only when its gap to the runner-up exceeds the round-to-round spread of both; otherwise it
reports them as tied.

When it finishes, verify and report:
1. The output JSON exists and parses: results/<OUTNAME>.json
2. Every configuration passed correctness (the script drops any that fail against its fp32
   reference and prints "FAILS CORRECTNESS" — report whether any did).
3. Per configuration: the median ms, the round-to-round spread percentage, and whether it is
   in the reported tied set.
4. The verdict line: best configuration, gap to runner-up, round noise, separated-or-tied,
   and the speedup vs the all-unfused baseline.
5. Anything anomalous: a spread above ~1%, a configuration whose median is wildly different
   from the others, or MACA driver errors in the log (lines containing MCR/MXKW/Xnack).

Report the numbers. Do not interpret whether fusion is "worth it" — that judgement is made
elsewhere with both runs in hand.
`

const SCHEMA = {
  type: 'object',
  properties: {
    regime: { type: 'string' },
    results_json: { type: 'string' },
    all_correct: { type: 'boolean' },
    best: { type: 'string' },
    separated: { type: 'boolean' },
    tied_set: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' } },
    speedup_vs_unfused: { type: 'number' },
    configs: {
      type: 'array',
      items: {
        type: 'object',
        properties: {
          name: { type: 'string' },
          median_ms: { type: 'number' },
          spread_pct: { type: 'number' },
          in_tied_set: { type: 'boolean' },
        },
        required: ['name', 'median_ms'],
      },
    },
    anomalies: { type: 'string' },
  },
  required: ['regime', 'results_json', 'all_correct', 'best', 'configs'],
}

phase('Replicate')
log('Second independent A/B: decode_bs512 on GPU 1, decode_bs1024 on GPU 3')

const results = await parallel([
  () =>
    agent(
      COMMON +
        `\n# YOUR ASSIGNMENT\nGPU: **CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1**\nREGIME: **decode_bs512**\n` +
        `OUTNAME: **layer_configurations_ab_new2_bs512**\n`,
      { label: 'ab2-bs512', phase: 'Replicate', schema: SCHEMA }
    ),
  () =>
    agent(
      COMMON +
        `\n# YOUR ASSIGNMENT\nGPU: **CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=3**\nREGIME: **decode_bs1024**\n` +
        `OUTNAME: **layer_configurations_ab_new2_bs1024**\n`,
      { label: 'ab2-bs1024', phase: 'Replicate', schema: SCHEMA }
    ),
])

return { replicates: results.filter(Boolean) }

replicates.results_json: NOT YET WRITTEN — /home/zhangshuhan/fusion/results/layer_configurations_ab_new2_bs512.json does not exist (verified with ls, exit code 2). The run is still executing.
replicates.best: UNDETERMINED — run incomplete, no rounds have finished
replicates.anomalies:
RUN INCOMPLETE — THIS IS NOT A RESULT REPORT. I was forced to emit structured output before the benchmark finished, so every result field is a placeholder, not a measurement. Do NOT compare this against the other run.

STATE AT TIME OF REPORTING: the job was launched correctly on GPU 1 as `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 nohup python -u glm52/bench/bench_layer_ab.py --regimes decode_bs512 --rounds 8 --rep 15 --top 5 --force K_f3_f8,D_f6 --out layer_configurations_ab_new2_bs512`, logging to /tmp/ab_decode_bs512.log. It is alive and progressing normally. The log contains exactly four lines: the regime header, the candidate list, "[cfgs] reusing _layer_cfgs_decode_bs512.json", and "[shared] tuning w13 (26), act (18), w2 (26)". It is still in the shared-tuning phase that precedes the correctness checks and the 8 timing rounds. Zero rounds have printed. Elapsed time is only a few minutes against an expected 15-25 minutes.

FIELD-BY-FIELD CAVEATS:
- all_correct=false is NOT a correctness failure. The script runs its fp32 reference check after tuning; that phase has not been reached, so no "FAILS CORRECTNESS" line could have appeared either way. The value is false only because "all configurations passed" has not been established. Zero configurations have been checked.
- best, tied_set, separated, and speedup_vs_unfused are unknown. No medians, no round-to-round spreads, and no verdict line exist yet.
- configs is empty because no per-configuration timing data exists. No median ms, no spread percentages, no tied-set membership can be reported.

WHAT IS KNOWN AND VALID SO FAR:
- 7 candidate configurations were selected, matching the expected count: H_f3_f10, E_f10, C_f1, B_f3, A_all_unfused, K_f3_f8, D_f6. Both forced configs (K_f3_f8, D_f6) and the A_all_unfused baseline are present.
- No MACA driver errors so far: no MCR, MXKW, or Xnack lines; no Traceback; no OOM.
- GPU assignment is correct and isolated. mx-smi showed the only other python process on GPU 0 (the other agent); GPU 2 is "Not Available" as expected and was never touched. GPU 1 was idle at launch.
- No source file was modified; nothing was tuned or "improved". The command was run verbatim as assigned.

TO OBTAIN THE ACTUAL RESULT: re-poll /tmp/ab_decode_bs512.log until it prints "wrote results/layer_configurations_ab_new2_bs512.json", then read /home/zhangshuhan/fusion/results/layer_configurations_ab_new2_bs512.json. A persistent monitor (task bh1fz50op) is armed on the log and will surface each round line, any FAILS CORRECTNESS line, the verdict line, the speedup-vs-unfused line, and any MCR/MXKW/Xnack driver error. The run must be allowed to finish before any comparison against the first run is made.

replicates.results_json: NOT YET WRITTEN. Expected path: /home/zhangshuhan/fusion/results/layer_configurations_ab_new2_bs1024.json — confirmed absent at time of reporting. The benchmark (PID 3597555, CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=3) is still running and has completed only 2 of 8 interleaved rounds. Live log: /tmp/ab_decode_bs1024.log
replicates.best: H_f3_f10 (PROVISIONAL — from 2 of 8 rounds only; not the script's verdict, which has not been emitted)
replicates.anomalies:
PRIMARY CAVEAT — RUN IS INCOMPLETE. I was required to return output before the benchmark finished. Only rounds 0 and 1 of 8 have been emitted. Every number in `configs`, `best`, and `speedup_vs_unfused` above is my own arithmetic over those 2 rounds, NOT the script's output. Do NOT compare these against the first run as if they were a finished replicate:
- "median_ms" is the midpoint of 2 samples, not a median over 8 rounds.
- "spread_pct" over 2 samples systematically UNDERSTATES the true round-to-round spread (range grows with sample count). These are not comparable to the prior run's 8-round spreads.
- `separated` and `tied_set` are deliberately omitted: the script has not run its verdict logic, and the leader margin (H_f3_f10 vs E_f10 = 0.0067 ms) is far below the observed per-config range, so a tie/separation call is not yet supportable.
- speedup_vs_unfused (21.5767/21.53105) is provisional for the same reason.

WHAT IS GENUINELY ESTABLISHED:
- all_correct=true is real, not provisional. The script runs its fp32 correctness check on all candidates BEFORE the timing loop and drops failures. No "FAILS CORRECTNESS" line appeared, and all 7 candidates appear in the round-0/round-1 timing output, so all 7 passed against the fp32 reference at tol=5e-2.
- Candidate set matches the prior run exactly (7 configs: H_f3_f10, E_f10, C_f1, A_all_unfused, B_f3, K_f3_f8, D_f6).
- No source file was modified; no tuning or flags were changed from the assigned command.

CLEAN SO FAR:
- No MACA driver errors: zero lines containing MCR, MXKW, or Xnack in the log.
- No tracebacks, OOM, or aborts.
- All observed spreads are well under the ~1% threshold (max 0.13%), though see the 2-sample caveat above.
- No config median is wildly out of family; D_f6 (~25.0 ms) and K_f3_f8 (~22.1 ms) are the expected slow outliers and sit within ~0.2% of their values in the prior run.

GPU HYGIENE VERIFIED:
- My process 3597555 confirmed running with CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=3.
- The other agent's process 3598369 confirmed on CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 — separate GPU, no contention.
- Two extra PIDs (3599733/3599734) briefly matched a pgrep but were transient shell artifacts that had already exited; there was NO duplicate run competing for GPU 3.
- GPU 2 confirmed "Not Available" in mx-smi, untouched.

NOTE ON BASELINE: the prior run (results/layer_configurations_ab_new.json) was recorded 2026-07-28 09:30:18 on visible_devices "0"; this replicate is on device 3. Prior bs1024 medians for reference: H_f3_f10 21.5590, E_f10 21.5704, C_f1 21.5840, B_f3 21.5973, A_all_unfused 21.6061, K_f3_f8 22.4564, D_f6 24.9802 (verdict: TIED, best H_f3_f10, speedup 1.00218).

TO COMPLETE: the run needs ~15-20 more minutes. A Monitor (task blurpeab0) and a background waiter (task baxpeb08b) are both armed and will fire on completion. Re-invoke to collect the real 8-round medians, spreads, verdict line, and tied set from results/layer_configurations_ab_new2_bs1024.json once "wrote results/..." appears.
